name: project-nanda-mcp
title: Project NANDA Documentation & Tools MCP Server
description: Provides tools and resources for AI agents to query Project NANDA documentation, inspect architectural models, and resolve agent identities.

tools.name: get_nanda_overview
tools.description: Returns the foundational overview, mission, and the city analogy (streets, tools, address system, passport).

tools.name: resolve_subject_identity
tools.description: Simulates or queries the NANDA Index resolution pipeline for a given subject identity (domain, DID, email, platform ID).

tools.name: list_community_chapters
tools.description: Returns the list of active Project NANDA chapters worldwide, including SF Bay Area, New Jersey, AusNZ, and Spain.
